name: Jatamansi
kitchenUse: Not a kitchen herb; taken as powder or in formulations, or in hair oil.

typicalUse.adultAmount: Only as a qualified practitioner advises; products and strengths vary
typicalUse.note: The plant is endangered in the wild; choose cultivated, certified sources.

cautions.note: Not enough is known; avoid in pregnancy and while breastfeeding.

interactions.effect: May add to drowsiness from sleeping pills and sedatives.

evidence.summary: Animal studies suggest calming effects; there are almost no trials in people.

sources.title: The Ayurvedic Pharmacopoeia of India, Part I
